newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean economy to continue cooling - minister.
newsitem.headline: Chilean economy to continue cooling - minister.

text.p: Chile's economy will continue slowing in coming months as the Central Bank's tight monetary policy succeeds in reining in breakneck growth, said Economy Minister Alvaro Garcia.
"We must be prepared to have monthly growth rates in coming months which are lower than those earlier this year," Garcia told reporters.
He said the lower growth rates will also reflect a high comparative base in the second half of last year, when the economy expanded rapidly.
"This is a natural result of the process of tightening which the country is experiencing. It is also a statistical phenomenum related to the high growth rates seen in the second half of last year."
Official figures show economic growth slowed to 5.8 percent in July from 6.3 percent in June and nearly eight percent in the first half of the year.
Despite the credit-squeeze, Chile's economy will expand by around seven percent this year -- the highest growth rate in Latin America, said Garcia.
